BATCH_OVERFLOW.scenario: Batch capacity dropped the oldest queued batch, or incoming data if all batches were active.

DELIVERY_FAILED.scenario: A bounded output attempt failed; cause retains the original timeout or delivery failure.

FORWARD_CYCLE.scenario: A new forwarding edge would reach its own source through existing target edges.

FORWARD_SELF.scenario: A host cannot register itself as a forwarding target.

HOOK_FAILED.scenario: A failure listener failed while observing another failure; the terminal reporter receives it.

INVALID_OPTION.scenario: Invalid construction/configuration input requires a corrected caller option.

INVALID_RETRY_COUNT.scenario: Retry attempts must be a positive safe integer before any output is installed.

LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE.scenario: A bounded flush/shutdown phase ran out of its shared lifecycle wait budget.

PIPELINE_ENTRY_INVALID.scenario: A pipeline replacement lost its Date; delivery keeps the prior valid entry and reports it.

PLUGIN_CONFIG_CONFLICT.scenario: An existing plugin configuration conflicts with a new installation.

PLUGIN_SHUTDOWN_CLEANUP_FAILED.scenario: Terminal cleanup failed; callers inspect the structured disposal result and original cause.

PLUGIN_UNINSTALL_CLEANUP_FAILED.scenario: Plugin release attempted all owned cleanup but at least one cleanup failed.

QUEUE_OVERFLOW.scenario: Entry admission dropped the oldest unprocessed entry to maintain the pending bound.

RUNTIME_SHUTTING_DOWN.scenario: Configuration admission has closed during terminal shutdown.
